name: Forest In The Dark - Kuraki Mori ni Tsudou Yume
original_name: フォレスト・イン・ザ・ダーク　暗き森に集う夢
source:
The elder of the clan dies and leaves mysterious instructions to determine his heir - to find memory card game and play it to the end till next full moon. There are only several days left till the next full moon and thus hero arrives to the forest mansion to try his luck.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一族长老去世后，留下了一道谜样的指示，以此决定继承人：找到一款翻牌记忆游戏，并在下次满月前将它通关。距离下次满月只剩几天，主角便来到森林中的宅邸，准备一试运气。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
